tests.name: Binance Crypto: coupled retention matrix (6 observables)
tests.observable_names: BTC_price, BTC_volume, ETH_price, ETH_volume, SOL_price, SOL_volume
tests.verdict_note: SUPPORTED: principal eigenmode of coupled observables fits S2 better than individual single curves. This supports T7: S2 governs the dominant retention mode, not individual observables. The coupling matrix R_ij captures how different MM topological features interact in the 4D projection.
tests.narrative: Binance Crypto: 6 coupled observables analyzed. Cross-retention matrix R_ij(λ) computed with 25 lags. Principal eigenvalue fitted to S2: D_eff=0.6199, λ_q=197.8768, R²=0.9942. Average single-curve R²=0.8279. Eigenmode fit is BETTER than average single-curve fit. Coupling strength=0.414 (High (strong coupling)). Principal retention mode fits S2 better than any individual observable — supports T7.
